UpdateSourceData:
# autoconfig.cfg - King Arthur's Gold
# Pose par le template AMP TeamKit.
#
# AMP reecrit au demarrage toutes les valeurs qu'il gere : modifie-les dans
# l'onglet Configuration d'AMP, pas ici, sinon elles seront ecrasees.
#
# Attention : KAG peut reecrire ce fichier lui-meme en s'arretant, en y
# remettant ses commentaires en fin de ligne. C'est prevu, le template sait
# les relire.

sv_name = FR TeamKit
sv_info = Serveur communautaire TeamKit.fr

sv_gamemode = CTF
sv_mapcycle = 
sv_mapcycle_shuffle = 1
sv_mapautocycle = 1
sv_gravity = 9.81
sv_bots = 0

sv_maxplayers = 32
sv_reservedslots = 0
sv_enable_joinfull = 1
sv_maxping = 350
sv_maxping_warnings = 600
sv_maxhack_warnings = 25
sv_alloweditor = 1
sv_freezeban_time = 30

sv_password = 
sv_rconpassword = 
sv_port = 50301
sv_register = 1
sv_sendminimap = 1
sv_tcpr = 0

sv_allow_globals_mods = 1
sv_global_bans = 0
sv_verify_mods = 1

sv_canpause = 1
sv_compression = 1
sv_restart_on_update = 1

security_whitelist_active = 0
security_whitelist = Security/whitelist.cfg
security_blacklist = Security/blacklist.cfg
security_ignorelist = Security/ignorelist.cfg
security_hidenamelist = Security/hidenamelist.cfg
security_seclevs = Security/seclevs.cfg
